voiceover_beat: One of 18 clubs kept 24 clean sheets in 34 matches yet did not win title
visual_direction: 18 neutral team nodes; one node glows amber. Numbers 24 / 34 pop forward; trophy fades behind question mark.
animation_transition: Dots converge; do not reveal team until narration names Hearts.
production_cautions: Avoid fake or unauthorized official league crests.

voiceover_beat: Hearts of Oak conceded only 15 goals during season
visual_direction: Hearts name enters, one large 15 counter; a goal mouth outline appears.
animation_transition: Smooth count up 0 → 15, no fake match footage.
production_cautions: Club badge if licensed; name-only typography otherwise.

visual_direction: 24 numbered game tiles light up in teal in 6×4 grid.
production_cautions: These represent clean-sheet matches, not all 34.

voiceover_beat: 13 of 24 clean sheets were goalless draws; neither side scored
visual_direction: 13 of 24 tiles flip to gold 0–0 scoreboards; 11 remain teal. Giant 13 isolates.
animation_transition: Tiles flip; pause 0.7–1.2 seconds on 13; audible beat.
production_cautions: Maintain honest set relationship: 13 is a subset of 24.

voiceover_beat: Stopping goals alone does not win a match; scoring matters
visual_direction: Split screen shield vs ball. Shield stays fixed; football crosses the divider to a net.
animation_transition: Shape morph from shield to two halves; no misleading footage.
production_cautions: Visual metaphor only, not a measured statistic.

visual_direction: Score counter changes from opponent goals 15 to Hearts goals 25, with clear new label.
animation_transition: Use clear label switch to avoid confusing conceded and scored.
production_cautions: Do not imply the 25 occurred in 25 different matches.

voiceover_beat: 0.74 goals per team per match vs league average 1.02
visual_direction: Side-by-side bars on common 0–1.2 scale; Hearts gold 0.74, league ivory 1.02. Small footnote equal units.
animation_transition: Bars animate together, not as unrelated percentage bars.
production_cautions: League average is per TEAM per match, not total goals per match.

voiceover_beat: Hearts did not score in 18 of 34 matches
visual_direction: 34 match tiles in order. 18 dim to charcoal, remaining 16 brighten; counter displays 18.
production_cautions: 13 goalless draws form part of the 18 scoreless matches; do not suggest additional.

voiceover_beat: Medeama were champions; both teams lost 6 matches
visual_direction: Two labelled columns Hearts and Medeama; both LOSS counters rise to 6 side-by-side.
animation_transition: Equal-height bars emphasise matching loss totals.
production_cautions: No claims about strength/tactics beyond results.

visual_direction: Wins bars grow 17 vs 13, then progress to final points ladder 62 vs 54 and 8-point bracket.
animation_transition: Replace win charts with points, not overlay all stats at once.
production_cautions: Four extra wins replacing draws yields 8 extra points, descriptively.

voiceover_beat: Brilliant defending did not become enough victories
visual_direction: Return to 24-tile motif; 13 gold 0–0 tiles linger, then resolve to GilB wordmark and series tagline.
animation_transition: Fade to Midnight background; 1.5s brand hold.
production_cautions: Do not imply one causal factor proved by match-score data alone.
